m.aarti.tek: The āratī of the holy Rāmāyaṇa, lovely and adorned with the glory of Sītā's beloved Lord.
m.aarti.pad1: Brahmā and the other gods, the sage Nārada and Vālmīki, skilled in wisdom, sing it; so do Śuka, Sanaka and his brothers, Śeṣa and Sarasvatī; and Hanumān, son of the Wind, has told of its fair glory.
m.aarti.pad2: The Vedas, the eighteen Purāṇas and all six śāstras sing it; it is the essence of the scriptures. It is the wealth of sages and the all-in-all of saints, the very essence, approved by all.
m.aarti.pad3: Śiva and Pārvatī sing it without end, and so does the wise sage Agastya, born of a pot; Vyāsa and other great poets have praised it. It dwells in the hearts of Kākabhuśuṇḍi and Garuḍa.
m.aarti.pad4: It takes away the stains of the Kali age and makes the taste of sense-pleasures flat; it is the lovely adornment of the maiden Liberation. It is the herb of nectar that destroys the disease of worldly existence, and to Tulasīdāsa it is father and mother in every way.
